preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(s, str) for s in A)
preconditions.description: All elements in A are strings.
The length of A is between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(len(s) == len(A[0]) for s in A)
preconditions.description: All strings in A have the same length.

preconditions.expression: all(len(s) >= 1 and len(s) <= 100 for s in A)
preconditions.description: The length of each string in A is between 1 and 100.

postconditions.description: The return value is a non-negative integer.
The return value is less than or equal to the length of the strings in A.

postconditions.expression: all(all(A[i][j] <= A[i][j+1] for j in range(len(A[i])-1)) for i in range(len(A)))
postconditions.description: After deleting the specified columns, each row in A is in lexicographic order.
